require 'openssl'
require 'json'
require 'digest'

module SmartContract
  class CircuitBreaker
    FAILURE_THRESHOLD = 5
    RESET_TIMEOUT = 30

    attr_reader :state, :failure_count

    def initialize
      @state = :closed
      @failure_count = 0
      @last_failure_time = nil
    end

    def call(&block)
      case @state
      when :open
        if Time.now - @last_failure_time >= RESET_TIMEOUT
          @state = :half_open
          try_call(&block)
        else
          raise "CircuitBreaker is OPEN - rejecting request"
        end
      when :closed, :half_open
        try_call(&block)
      end
    end

    private

    def try_call(&block)
      result = block.call
      on_success
      result
    rescue => e
      on_failure
      raise e
    end

    def on_success
      @failure_count = 0
      @state = :closed
    end

    def on_failure
      @failure_count += 1
      @last_failure_time = Time.now
      if @failure_count >= FAILURE_THRESHOLD
        @state = :open
      end
    end
  end

  class TransactionValidator
    BLOCK_SIZE = 16
    KEY_SIZE = 16

    def initialize(key_hex)
      @key = [key_hex].pack('H*')
      unless @key.bytesize == KEY_SIZE
        raise ArgumentError, "Invalid key: AES-128 requires a #{KEY_SIZE}-byte key (#{KEY_SIZE * 2} hex characters)"
      end
      @circuit_breaker = CircuitBreaker.new
    end

    def encrypt_transaction(payload)
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher::AES.new(128, :CBC)
      cipher.encrypt
      cipher.key = @key
      iv = cipher.random_iv
      padded = pkcs7_pad(payload)
      encrypted = cipher.update(padded) + cipher.final
      iv + encrypted
    end

    def validate_and_decrypt(sealed_tx)
      @circuit_breaker.call do
        perform_decryption(sealed_tx)
      end
    end

    def circuit_state
      @circuit_breaker.state
    end

    private

    def perform_decryption(sealed_tx)
      raise "Invalid transaction length" if sealed_tx.length < BLOCK_SIZE * 2
      raise "Invalid alignment" if sealed_tx.length % BLOCK_SIZE != 0

      iv = sealed_tx[0...BLOCK_SIZE]
      ciphertext = sealed_tx[BLOCK_SIZE..]

      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher::AES.new(128, :CBC)
      cipher.decrypt
      cipher.key = @key
      cipher.iv = iv
      cipher.padding = 0

      plaintext = cipher.update(ciphertext) + cipher.final
      validated = strip_pkcs7(plaintext)
      
      JSON.parse(validated)
    end

    def strip_pkcs7(data)
      pad_byte = data[-1].ord
      if pad_byte < 1 || pad_byte > BLOCK_SIZE
        raise "Decryption failed: invalid transaction"
      end
      padding = data[-(pad_byte)..]
      unless padding.bytes.all? { |b| b == pad_byte }
        raise "Decryption failed: invalid transaction"
      end
      data[0...(data.length - pad_byte)]
    end

    def pkcs7_pad(data)
      pad_len = BLOCK_SIZE - (data.length % BLOCK_SIZE)
      data + (pad_len.chr * pad_len)
    end
  end

  class BlockchainNode
    attr_reader :chain, :pending_transactions

    def initialize(encryption_key)
      @validator = TransactionValidator.new(encryption_key)
      @chain = [genesis_block]
      @pending_transactions = []
    end

    def submit_sealed_transaction(sealed_tx_hex)
      sealed_tx = [sealed_tx_hex].pack('H*')
      begin
        tx_data = @validator.validate_and_decrypt(sealed_tx)
        @pending_transactions << tx_data
        { status: 'accepted', circuit: @validator.circuit_state }
      rescue => e
        { status: 'rejected', error: 'invalid transaction', circuit: @validator.circuit_state }
      end
    end

    def mine_block
      return nil if @pending_transactions.empty?
      prev = @chain.last
      block = {
        index: prev[:index] + 1,
        timestamp: Time.now.to_i,
        transactions: @pending_transactions.dup,
        previous_hash: prev[:hash],
        hash: nil
      }
      block[:hash] = compute_hash(block)
      @chain << block
      @pending_transactions.clear
      block
    end

    private

    def genesis_block
      { index: 0, timestamp: 0, transactions: [], previous_hash: '0' * 64,
        hash: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest('genesis') }
    end

    def compute_hash(block)
      data = "#{block[:index]}#{block[:timestamp]}#{block[:transactions]}#{block[:previous_hash]}"
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(data)
    end
  end
end
